snippet.description:
Learn the key differences between addition and condensation polymerization in this Class 10 Chemistry Chapter 26 video. This tutorial is designed for Matric students following the PCTB curriculum and preparing for FBISE, Punjab Board, and other Pakistani examination boards.

In this lesson, we explain what polymerization is, how addition polymerization works through monomer linkage, and how condensation polymerization differs by releasing small molecules like water. You'll understand the mechanisms, examples (like PVC and nylon), and why these distinctions matter in organic chemistry.

Key topics covered:
• Definition and types of polymerization
• Addition polymerization process and examples
• Condensation polymerization and byproducts
• Key differences and similarities
• Real-world applications of polymers
• Important reactions for Class 10 Chemistry

This video is perfect for Matric students in Pakistan studying under the National Curriculum, whether you attend a Federal Board, Punjab Board (Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad), Sindh Board, or KPK Board school. The content aligns with PCTB textbooks and covers essential concepts tested in annual and periodic exams.

Whether you're revising Chapter 26 or learning this topic for the first time, this step-by-step explanation makes polymerization easy to understand. Don't forget to like this video, subscribe to the channel for more Class 10 Chemistry tutorials, and comment with any questions!
